prompt: In 120 to 180 words, compare micro and macro averaging for multiclass metrics in exactly four numbered points. Include when each is preferable and finish with a one-sentence conclusion.

turns.assistant_message:
Micro-averaging and macro-averaging are two different methods used to calculate multiclass performance metrics, such as precision, recall, and F1-score, when dealing with imbalanced datasets.

Macro-averaging calculates the average metric for each class separately and then takes the mean of those averages. This method gives equal weight to all classes, making it suitable when the dataset is balanced or when the model's performance on minor classes is important. Macro-averaging does not consider the relative sizes of classes in the dataset.
